title: 第 63章 师兄不好当呀

众人落座后，赵爷爷先说话了：“小璎她姑呀，想来志强也跟你说了是怎么回事儿了。我和这孩子有缘，不知你意下如何？”

杨麦香说：“老人家，您叫我麦香就行。您是有大本事的人。我家小璎命苦，先没了娘，现在又没了爹。我这么个姑姑也没本事。您能看得上这孩子是她的造化。”

赵爷爷笑呵呵的说：“麦香呀，既然你也同意今天我就做主了，以后小璎这孩子就是志强的弟子了。”

王野这时站了起来，拉起坐在杨麦香旁边的杨璎珞，走到吴志强旁边说：“小璎跪下，给师爷师父敬杯茶。”说完杨璎珞咕咚就跪了下来。

王野把事先准备的茶递给杨璎珞，杨璎珞接过茶碗恭恭敬敬的递给吴志强说：“师父喝茶。”吴志强喝了一口笑呵呵的说：“小璎乖，以后好好练功。”

王野又递给杨璎珞一杯茶说：“给师爷敬茶”。

杨璎珞又一次恭恭敬敬给赵爷爷敬茶。赵爷爷喝过茶后说“以后小璎也由你大师兄王野教导，有什么问题找你师兄。”

王野直接愣住了心想：“不对呀，这曹强可以说脑子不好使吴志强教不了，怎么这个小师妹也甩给我了。”

王野说：“赵爷爷，那我师父干啥？”

赵爷爷笑呵呵的说：“小野你就受点累一个羊也是赶两个羊也是放，不差这一个。”

王野垮着脸说：“赵爷爷我这个师兄是不是有点儿不好当呀？”

赵爷爷哈哈笑起来说：“这就是命，没办法。”

王野垂头丧气的抱着王笑笑开始吃饭，必须化悲愤为食欲。再说了不多吃点哪儿有力气教师弟师妹呀。

其实吴志强也不是很高兴，收了三个徒弟。一个自己也不能教，这对于一个师父来说呀挺悲催的。

这一桌菜对于王野来说就是家常菜，可是对于别人来说一辈子都没吃过。尤其是杨家三人，杨璎珞和杨琮是真的想像王野一样大快朵颐，可是他们不敢。

王野实在是看不下去了，站起来就把三人面前的碗里夹满了菜说：”赶紧吃呀，没见强子吃的多快呀，一会儿连汤都剩不下了。”

曹强不可思议的看着王野那意思是：“哥，我只是长得五大三粗的，吃饭还是很斯文的刚才大口大口干饭的好像是你吧？”可是曹强嘴笨，不会说只能这么看着王野。

王野瞟了一眼曹强说：“看什么看，菜不好吃呀？”

曹强委屈的点点头说：“好吃，特别好吃。”

王野没好气的说：“好吃还不吃，瞎看什么，我脸上有菜呀？”

曹强只能低头吃饭，他是脑子转的慢，又不是傻。明显王野被看得要生气了，这要是再看，明天可能就是对练了。

这下杨璎珞和杨琮也开始埋头吃饭，杨麦香也对王野投来感激的眼神。王野点点头继续埋头干饭。

一顿饭吃的那叫一个干净，盘子底都被刮干净了。王野站起来就要收拾碗筷，杨麦香也站了起来，王野也没有客气。就由着她一起收拾。

现在的人都这样，民风淳朴。一般不愿意占人便宜，极个别人不算。从一点就能体现出来，大多数人家的孩子在别人家玩的时候，只要一开饭肯定各回各家。

等到杨麦香涮完碗，众人都坐回了餐桌。赵爷爷说：“麦香啊，现在咱们也不算外人了，我想问问你，对于你哥的工作，你是怎么看的。总这么挂着也不是个办法，这等到小璎或许小琮得好几年呢，要不你先接了班吧？”

After everyone sat down, Grandpa Zhao spoke first: "Aunt Xiaoying, I think Zhiqiang also told you what happened. I have a fate with this child, what do you think?"

Yang Maixiang said: "Old man, just call me Maixiang. You are a person of great ability. My little Ying has a hard life. First she lost her mother, and now she loses her father. An aunt like me has no ability. You can see that this child is her creation."

Grandpa Zhao said with a smile: "Maixiang, since you agree, I will make the decision today. From now on, Xiaoying will be Zhiqiang's disciple."

Wang Ye stood up at this time, pulled up Yang Yingluo who was sitting next to Yang Maixiang, walked to Wu Zhiqiang and said, "Xiaoying, kneel down and offer a cup of tea to Master and Master." After saying this, Yang Yingluo knelt down.

Wang Ye handed the tea prepared in advance to Yang Yingluo. Yang Yingluo took the tea bowl and handed it to Wu Zhiqiang respectfully and said: "Master, drink tea." Wu Zhiqiang took a sip and said with a smile: "Good boy, practice hard in the future."

Wang Ye handed Yang Yingluo another cup of tea and said, "Tea for Master."

Yang Yingluo once again served tea to Grandpa Zhao respectfully.After drinking tea, Grandpa Zhao said, "Xiaoying will also be taught by your senior brother Wang Ye from now on. If you have any questions, please contact your senior brother."

Wang Ye was stunned and thought: "No, Cao Qiang can say that Wu Zhiqiang can't teach him because of his poor brain. Why did he leave this little junior sister to me?"

Wang Ye said: "Grandpa Zhao, what will my master do?"

Grandpa Zhao said with a smile: "Xiaoye, you are a little tired. You can drive two sheep or herd one sheep. This one is not bad."

Wang Ye said with a slumped face: "Grandpa Zhao, am I a bit difficult to be a senior brother?"

Grandpa Zhao laughed and said, "This is fate, there is nothing we can do about it."

Wang Ye hugged Wang Xiaoxiao dejectedly and started eating. He must turn his grief and anger into appetite.Besides, if you don’t eat more, how can I have the strength to teach my brothers and sisters?

In fact, Wu Zhiqiang was not very happy and accepted three apprentices.You can't teach anyone yourself, which is quite sad for a master.

For Wang Ye, this table of dishes is home-cooked food, but for others, they have never tasted it in their lives.Especially the three Yang family members, Yang Yingluo and Yang Cong, really wanted to feast like Wang Ye, but they didn't dare.

Wang Ye couldn't stand it any longer, so he stood up and filled the bowls in front of the three of them with vegetables and said, "Eat quickly. I didn't see how fast Qiangzi ate. There won't even be any soup left."

Cao Qiang looked at Wang Ye in disbelief, meaning: "Brother, I'm just tall and thick, and I eat very politely. I guess it was you who just gulped down the rice, right?" But Cao Qiang was stupid and couldn't say that he could only look at Wang Ye like this.

Wang Ye glanced at Cao Qiang and said, "What are you looking at? The food is not delicious?"

Cao Qiang nodded aggrievedly and said, "It's delicious, especially delicious."

Wang Ye said angrily: "It's delicious. Why don't you eat it? Why are you looking at it? Is there something wrong with my face?"

Cao Qiang could only lower his head to eat. His mind was slow, but he was not stupid.It was obvious that Wang Ye was getting angry. If he watched again, there might be a sparring session tomorrow.

Now Yang Yingluo and Yang Cong also began to immerse themselves in eating, and Yang Maixiang also cast a grateful look at Wang Ye.Wang Ye nodded and continued to work hard.

A meal is called a clean meal, and the bottom of the plate is scraped clean.Wang Ye stood up and was about to clear away the dishes. Yang Maixiang also stood up, and Wang Ye was not polite.Let her clean it up together.

People nowadays are like this, with simple folk customs.Generally speaking, we are not willing to take advantage of others, except for a few individuals.It can be seen from one point that when most children of other families play at other people's houses, they will definitely go back to their respective houses as soon as the meal is served.

After Yang Maixiang finished rinsing the bowl, everyone sat back at the dining table.Grandpa Zhao said: "Maixiang, we are not outsiders now. I want to ask you, what do you think of your brother's work? It's not an option to hang on like this all the time. It will take Xiaoying or Xiaocong a few years, why don't you take over first?"
